IncidentBot: PIR required for PROD outage (PROD-2026-03-14). Paging spike -> 5m of elevated 5xxs for customer-facing inference endpoints. Automated trigger: >3x error rate for 5m. Root cause unknown; we need a 60-90m PIR. Please claim facilitator + confirm attendees. Link to incident timeline & logs: https://rwinf.internal/incidents/PROD-2026-03-14

Samir K: I can be co-facilitator. prefer Tue/Wed afternoons UTC. Not available Mon morning.

Elaine R: I can facilitate if nobody else volunteers. Tue 16:00 UTC or Wed 09:00 PST both work for me. Also +1 to keeping it tight (60m). :thumbsup:

Lee: Quick ask — include a Customer Success rep from Acme and the runbook owner for inference-serving. We should prep SLO graphs, recent deploy timeline, and any fallback routing changes.

Maria T: I made a draft PIR doc here: https://docs.internal/pir/PROD-2026-03-14/draft. I can own the doc until the facilitator takes it over. Who will own the timeline curation?

Ops Rotation: attaching short log clip of the spike (last 6m):
```
2026-03-14T14:02:31Z ERROR grpc call failed code=13 route=generate model=llama-13b qps=420
2026-03-14T14:03:10Z WARN batch queue length=78 latency_p95=1.3s
2026-03-14T14:04:05Z ERROR kvcache miss rate increased 12%
```

Samir K: Elaine — would you be OK to take facilitator? I can co-facilitate and run the action-item tracker. Ops Rotation, can you tag the runbook owner (infra:kvcache) and add the deploy log snippet to the doc?

Elaine R: Yes I can facilitate. Booking provisional slot: Tue 2026-03-17 16:00 UTC (60m). Calendar invite: https://calendar.internal/event/abc123. If that doesn't work for some, please vote on the poll: https://doodle.com/poll/xyz456. I'll update the doc with agenda and pre-read by EOD tomorrow.

SRE-Oncall: I'll pull SLO graphs and attach the Grafana links to the doc. Also will bring the timeline from alerts -> mitigation steps.

Customer Success - Acme: Can confirm a rep will join Tue 16:00 UTC. They asked for a brief customer-facing summary in the pre-read.

Maria T: Action items (initial):
```
- Timeline curation -> SRE-Oncall (due before PIR)
- Runbook owner to review -> infra:kvcache (Ops Rotation to tag)
- Customer summary -> Customer Success - Acme (prep)
- Deploy/CI timeline -> Samir K (attach logs)
- Postmortem writeup -> Elaine R (owner)
```
I'll add these to the doc as checklist and create GH issues for remediation where applicable.

Lee: Proposal — limit slides to 6: timeline, impact, root-candidates, mitigations, action items, follow-ups. Also please add any regressions tests we want to trigger.

IncidentBot: Reminder: add the incident tag `severity:high` + `pir:required` to the incident record and attach final PIR to the incident ticket. PIR template: https://rwinf.internal/templates/pir-template.md

Elaine R: Thanks everyone — I'll send the official invite after polling results. If you cannot make Tue 16:00 UTC, drop available times in thread or update the doodle. Otherwise see you there. :calendar:
